items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: there was one trombonist that his name was Baptiste Delaney, and he said he was the best he ever heard.

ctx.x: He's a much slicker character. Yeah, yeah, yeah.

He's a pretty good businessman. Yeah, yeah, but Roy was the best trombone player ever left here. Now there's one fellow way years ago I heard, see I used to sit on the stand with Joe, Oliver and his band, and him talking about these different bands, and there was one trombonist that his name was Baptiste Delaney, and he said he was the best he ever heard. But this is what's supposed to happen to Baptiste. He lost his mind, and he used to climb the lamppost, you know, with his trombone. And of course a lot of…
Did you ever hear Earl Humphrey play?
